##### Project general facts

Aljada CBD Building 3, also known as Wing, is a contemporary office building by Arada within the first cluster of the central business district of the Aljada community. Conceived as an innovative corporate hub, it combines a modern facade with functional design that fits naturally into the surrounding urban fabric. The building rises above two basement levels, a ground floor and a podium level to eight office floors and a roof, positioned beside the landscaped green spine of the district.

The business environment is designed to support productivity and wellbeing. Spacious public areas, high-speed lifts, a welcoming lobby and concierge services create a professional first impression for staff and visitors. Advanced digital infrastructure with high-speed connectivity runs through the shared spaces, while a rooftop garden with seating areas, ground-floor retail and dining outlets, covered parking, round-the-clock security and access to a forest walk and landscaped lawns add comfort to the working day.

Offices offer flexible open-plan layouts that suit a wide range of businesses, from individual companies to growing teams. Generous floor plates, high-quality finishes and an emphasis on natural light create comfortable workplaces, while smart building systems support efficient operation. Units are delivered ready for the interior fit-out, giving each occupier the freedom to tailor the space to its brand, workflow and workplace culture.

##### Location description and benefits

Aljada is a large master-planned community in Sharjah that brings together homes, offices, retail, hospitality, education and leisure within one integrated urban setting. Its heart is Madar, a family entertainment destination designed by Zaha Hadid Architects, with parks, a skate park, a drive-in cinema, play areas and a wide choice of restaurants and cafes, alongside landscaped green spines and walkable streets.

Emirates Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and University City Road connect the community with the rest of Sharjah, Dubai and the northern emirates. Madar is a short walk away, Sharjah International Airport and University City are a short drive from the district, and Dubai International Airport and Downtown Dubai are within comfortable driving distance, making the location practical for staff and visiting clients.

Aljada is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the most ambitious mixed-use developments in Sharjah. Its central business district attracts companies seeking modern, well-connected workplaces at accessible prices compared with Dubai. A growing residential population, integrated retail and leisure and strong road links support steady demand from occupiers, underpinning healthy rental yields and long-term value for investors.
